texts.en:
In an appalling display of foolishness, a naval cadet has leaked classified information. A dedicated fan of networked combat simulators, the cadet got into an argument with other players about the angular velocity of the turrets on our destroyers.

To bolster their position, the cadet uploaded several classified blueprints of our ships, documents which quickly spread across the galactic network. Although the culprit has been dealt with, voices on the Council are calling for a wholesale ban on online gaming as a result of this incident.

label.en: It was time to modernize the fleet anyway.

summary.text:
# 间谍游戏 / Spy Games

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:4930-5088`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链后段：工作/家庭事件结束后隐藏事件 cyber.1000 从 on_futureshock_chain_leisure_events_list（7个事件，权重各5：休闲 1005/1010/1030/1055，社会 1205/1210/1255）抽取一个。
  Late part of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the work/family event hidden cyber.1000 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_leisure_events_list (7 events, weight 5 each: leisure 1005/1010/1030/1055, society 1205/1210/1255).
- 触发：银河社群已成立且自己是成员，且没有“神秘工程学”飞升天赋。
  Trigger: the Galactic Community exists and the empire is a member, without the Enigmatic Engineering ascension perk.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「间谍游戏」：入侵事件的应对——cyber_breach_overcome（军国加成）、cyber_breach_forgive、cyber_breach_ban，或花影响力。
  "Spy Games": responses to a breach: cyber_breach_overcome (militarist bonus), cyber_breach_forgive, cyber_breach_ban, or spend influence.
- 事件结束后180+随机90天由隐藏事件 cyber.1500 按政体权威选出最终事件 1505–1525 之一（跨故事的共享结局，视为枢纽）。
  After 180 days (+ random 90) hidden cyber.1500 picks one of the final events 1505-1525 by government authority (a shared ending across stories, treated as a hub).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
